copy-button.$description: CopyButton's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--copy-button-<name>) on the page, a container or one button, and every CopyButton inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The rest of its look comes from Button's tokens.

done-color.$description: The check icon once it has copied (3:1 on the button).
